hazard_statement_pictograms._comment: Primary pictogram + signal word per H-code, derived from Annex 3 Section 3's per-hazard-class tables. A handful of codes (H221, H229, H261, H272, H311/H331 category 3, H207) are assigned to more than one hazard category with a different pictogram/signal word each - this table picks the more common or more severe pairing as a single default, per developer-docs/design-choices.md. Combined codes (e.g. H300+H310) are not listed here - resolve by splitting on '+' and looking up each constituent code.
